items.label: 3 Compartments for Sorting
items.value: This laundry basket offers a total volume of 31.7 gallons (10.6 gallons per bag). The 3 compartments let you easily sort your laundry

items.label: Convenient Top Surface
items.value: The upper shelf of this laundry basket serves as an additional area for organizing or displaying items. Designed with slats, it allows for optimal airflow, helping to minimize unwanted odors

items.label: Removable & Washable Bags
items.value: Each bag is supported by a plastic panel at the bottom to prevent sagging. Thanks to the hook-and-loop fasteners, the bags are easy to remove for washing

items.label: Sturdy and Stable
items.value: With a 0.8" thick steel frame and MDF panel, the shelf of this laundry basket supports up to 55 lb. The Oxford fabric bags are water-resistant, and the 4 adjustable feet provide excellent stability

items.label: Versatile Use
items.value: This laundry hamper is ideal for a variety of settings, including the laundry room, bathroom, or bedroom
